title: cracca kraussiana
intro: Cracca kraussiana, commonly known as Krauss's cracca or climbing pea, is a plant species that belongs to the family Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems. The health benefits of Cracca kraussiana are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
